title: Highlight exact vertical triple endpoints
written_solution: Find every vertical run of a single color with length exactly 3. Recolor only the top and bottom cells of that run to cyan(8), leaving the center unchanged.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (f4-vertical-runs grid) (apply append (for/list ((c (in-range (cols grid)))) (let loop ((r 0) (acc (list))) (cond ((>= r (rows grid)) (reverse acc)) ((= (at grid r c) 0) (loop (+ r 1) acc)) (else (let* ((v (at grid r c)) (end (let walk ((rr r)) (if (and (< (+ rr 1) (rows grid)) (= (at grid (+ rr 1) c) v)) (walk (+ rr 1)) rr)))) (loop (+ end 1) (cons (list c r end v) acc))))))))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((run (in-list (f4-vertical-runs g)))) (let ((c (first run)) (r0 (second run)) (r1 (third run))) (if (= (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) 3) (set-cell (set-cell out r0 c 8) r1 c 8) out)))))
